title: 第11章 半夜美女来敲门第12章 机车少女
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 每进阶一次，全属性将获得翻倍，那种提升是极其恐怖的。
所以在1阶之前，属性越高，进阶翻倍后得到的收益最大。
比如，普通人初始属性值大部分都是：
升级每级四维增加5点，那麽升级到0阶10级属性值为：
【自由属性点：50】
一旦进阶1阶，那麽魔力将会到达11000，各属性也会成长到110点。
林羽现在的魔力是6500，升到0阶10级，会达到11500。
当他进阶1阶，魔力就会达到23000，比起普通人的11000的魔力，强大得太多太多了。
所以，1阶以前的属性是极其重要的。
有了计划，林羽也不在多想，躺在床上准备休息。
突然。
“咚咚咚！”
敲门声响起。
林羽眉头一皱，会是谁？谁会来找他？还是这个时候。
难道是那个小少妇？
林羽脑海中，莫名的浮现出小少妇那凹凸有致的玲珑身材，体内一股无名之火顿时窜起。
打开房门，一个青春靓丽的女孩出现在眼前。
“你是？”
林羽疑惑，居然不是那小少妇，心中莫名闪过一丝失落。
“大帅哥，不请我进去聊吗？”
女孩面容姣好，长发披肩，又黑又直，乌黑的大眼睛闪烁着狡黠的光芒。
她穿着牛仔短裤，露在外面的大腿肌肤细腻光滑，笔直而修长。
右脚踝处，挂着一道红绳铃铛。
上身白色机车服，将她的胸前凸显得更加饱满。
女孩没等林羽答应，她径直就走了进去。
content_en:
Every time you advance, all attributes will be doubled, and that kind of improvement is extremely terrifying.
Therefore, before level 1, the higher the attributes, the greater the benefits will be obtained after doubling the level.
For example, most of the initial attribute values of ordinary people are:
[Magic power: 500]
【Strength: 5】
[Physique: 5]
[Speed: 5]
【Spirit: 5】
The fourth dimension increases by 5 points for each level of upgrade. Then the attribute value after upgrading to level 0 and level 10 is:
[Magic power: 5500]
【Strength: 55】
[Physique: 55]
[Speed: 55]
【Spirit: 55】
[Free attribute points: 50]
Once you advance to level 1, your magic power will reach 11,000 and each attribute will grow to 110 points.
Lin Yu's current magic power is 6,500. When he reaches level 0 and level 10, it will reach 11,500.
When he advances to level 1, his magic power will reach 23,000, which is much more powerful than the 11,000 magic power of ordinary people.
Therefore, attributes before level 1 are extremely important.
With the plan in place, Lin Yu didn't think too much and lay on the bed ready to rest.
Sudden.
"Dong dong dong!"
There was a knock on the door.
Lin Yu frowned, who could it be? Who will come to him? Still at this time.
Could it be that little young woman?
In Lin Yu's mind, the young woman's curvy and exquisite figure appeared inexplicably, and an unknown fire suddenly sprang up in her body.
Opening the door, a young and beautiful girl appeared in front of her.
"You are?"
Lin Yu was confused, it was not the young woman, and a trace of disappointment flashed in his heart.
"Handsome guy, won't you invite me in to chat?"
The girl has a beautiful face, long hair shawl, black and straight, and big black eyes with a cunning light.
She was wearing denim shorts, and the skin of her exposed thighs was delicate and smooth, straight and slender.
A red rope bell hangs from his right ankle.
The white motorcycle suit on her upper body made her breasts fuller.
The girl walked in without waiting for Lin Yu to agree.
title_en: Chapter 11 A beautiful woman knocks on the door in the middle of the night Chapter 12 A motorcycle girl
